bullets.text: Co-facilitated grant writing for the ACCESS Indian Canyon project, which earned a $50 million LTCAP grant.
Introduced SharePoint collaboration to grant writing, replacing the practice of piecing together dated content from earlier applications that each had a different structure and audience.

Introduced AI into the grant production workflow for the RAISE grant by demonstrating it in production meetings. It restructured content quickly, saved days of proofreading by checking the application against the RFP, and surfaced connections the team had missed.
Introduced an AI-enhanced grant alignment workflow that increased efficiency and compliance with federal and state funding criteria.
When the RAISE grant was changed to the BUILD grant with a new RFP and the same deadline, used the new workflow to retarget the application promptly.
Advocated for a centralized, maintained repository of ACCESS Indian Canyon content so accurate, appropriately structured grant applications can be produced without patchwork.
Designed multi-agency grant deliverables integrating policy text, visuals, and compliance documentation in a unified format.
Created visual narratives to support major grant applications, regional initiatives, and budget communications.
Created internal grant development infrastructure that improved coordination and alignment between departments.
Designed and developed an in-house pairwise comparison survey web app to engage stakeholders and prioritize regional transportation projects, saving CVAG $9,500.
Built the pairwise comparison survey that CVAG used for its new TPPS.
bullets.note: TPPS is Kevin's abbreviation. Spell it out only if he supplies the full name.

bullets.text: Built the survey app from scratch with custom logic and a tailored interface for the Executive Director to use on a touchscreen in front of stakeholders. It was a first-of-its-kind internal tool for CVAG.
Translated survey data into visual reports and storytelling for stakeholders using PowerPoint, Excel, and Adobe InDesign.

Built an in-house typography and template system using Microsoft cloud fonts, chosen for platform compatibility, to future-proof agency materials for digital and print use. It produced the 2024/25 CVAG and CVCC annual budget books.
Created a dual-format publishing workflow: complex publications designed in InDesign while staff maintain design integrity in Word for collaboration. SharePoint links render correctly across devices.
Optimized the workflow for CVAG's budget books using InDesign, Word, and PDF export automation, for both print and digital.
Designed and developed annual reports, budget books, grant applications, public presentations, event collateral, and fact sheets for four regional agencies.
Designed and produced hundreds of branded PowerPoint presentations for public board and committee meetings.
Developed style guidelines and deployed templates for print and presentations, and implemented design systems, Microsoft 365 templates, and SharePoint-based document governance across departments.
Centralized reusable digital assets into quality-controlled SharePoint libraries.
Used Microsoft 365's capabilities to avoid unnecessary software purchases.

Built a custom hybrid video-meeting A/V system for a conference room that was not designed for hybrid meetings. After a power surge disabled the existing equipment, reverse-engineered the system topology, identified the breaks, and assembled a mobile system that outperforms the built-in one for less than $900.
Ran the A/V system for over 200 elected committee and special presentations using PowerPoint, Teams, and custom hybrid meeting setups.
Independently managed and developed the CVAG and CVCC websites in WordPress, ensuring accessibility, accuracy, and transparency in public communications.
Directed web contractors on improving usability, mobile responsiveness, and document access for residents and stakeholders.
Published agendas, newsletters, committee packets, and announcements to meet Brown Act requirements and foster civic engagement.
Developed and published content, such as photos and stories, for communication materials.
Monitored, updated, and responded as needed on CVAG's social media accounts.
Collaborated with executive leadership to craft clear, community-focused messaging for programs in transportation, sustainability, and regional planning.
Prepared draft reports, memoranda, talking points, fact sheets, and presentation materials for management review.
Supported public meetings, ceremonies, and outreach events with custom-designed visual assets and technical logistics.
Coordinated communications and presentation strategy for multiple agencies housed under CVAG, including DCE and CVCC, and served as liaison for internal branding needs.
Served as a contact and provided support for inter-government coordination and engagement in projects, programs, and policy issues.
Guided colleagues one-on-one on branding, presentation strategy, and communication best practices.
Implemented structured, transparent performance planning systems to align duties and deliverables across departments.
Scheduled and coordinated meetings, and attended meetings and took notes as assigned.

bullets.text: Grew a two-person collaboration into a ten-person full-service branding, marketing, and web development agency.

Recruited, mentored, and directed local designers and web developers, supervising two designers and two developers, delegating tasks, and providing constructive feedback and support for professional growth.
Managed the creative process from concept to completion, ensuring projects met deadlines and budget constraints, and presented ideas and final products to stakeholders.
Collaborated with Coachella Valley business owners, publications, paper wholesalers, print shops, and print vendors to develop, execute, and manage marketing and messaging strategies.
Communicated with clients to understand their vision and requirements, presented creative concepts, and refined work based on feedback.
Collaborated directly with business owners and nonprofit clients to align marketing efforts with organizational goals and community impact.
Designed and wrote client presentations, pitch decks, and informational videos.
Developed and maintained brand visual identities, ensured consistency across all branding materials, and aligned branding strategies with client marketing teams.
Conceptualized and designed print advertisements, oversaw production for high-quality output, and coordinated with printers and other vendors.
Developed direct mail campaigns in adherence to USPS guidelines.
Developed and managed responsive web, email, and social media campaigns.
Directed photo shoots of people, products, and places.
Managed and grew social media presence for agency clients on Instagram and Facebook, developing content calendars, publishing schedules, and engagement strategies.
Created original graphics, photography, and video content tailored to each platform and campaign objective.

Wrote, edited, and proofed campaign copy across social media, email, websites, and print collateral for accuracy, clarity, and brand voice, and reviewed and approved copy for consistency and brand alignment.
Planned and executed email campaigns in Mailchimp and Constant Contact, including audience segmentation, list hygiene, and performance tracking.
Maintained and organized mailing lists to ensure data accuracy, healthy engagement metrics, and honest reporting.
Developed campaign-specific calls to action suited to each platform, audience, and touchpoint.
Planned, launched, and optimized paid digital advertising campaigns on Google Ads, Facebook, and Instagram.
Generated performance reports for clients, analyzing engagement, reach, and campaign effectiveness to inform strategy adjustments.

Created and maintained client websites using WordPress, supporting SEO best practices, WCAG accessibility standards, and WooCommerce, and guided the visual design, UX, and UI of websites in collaboration with developers.

Produced and supported livestream and virtual events, including the 2020 Virtual Art Party fundraiser for the Palm Springs Art Museum, coordinating visual assets, streaming setup, and promotional content during the COVID-19 pandemic.
Registered trademarks and researched patents through the USPTO.
Stayed current with industry trends and emerging technologies and implemented best practices in design and branding.
Completely modernized server, workstation, telephone, and network infrastructure across 3 locations.
Maintained The Museum System (TMS) digital asset and collections database, ensuring image and metadata integrity.
Maintained CRM systems used for member and donor communications.
Collaborated with event, media, and development teams to design and operate live visuals for Meet the Museum and other public events, supporting donor engagement and public programs.
VJ'd the 2014 Meet the Museum White Party launch fundraiser, designing original graphics and collaborating directly with the musical entertainment.
Supported staff at all levels up to the Executive Director, using reflective and empathic listening to identify problems and recognize opportunities.
Joined the website rebuild team, focusing on device compatibility, improved load times, and WCAG 2.0 accessibility compliance for people with disabilities.
Created a print-to-online workflow converting the printed course catalog's InDesign source file into appropriately styled HTML web pages.
Directed art and programming for a 3D-modeled, browser-based children's game.
Designed the customer-facing GUI for a national digital signage network.
Worked as an online ad and creative designer, webmaster, and archivist.
